icons.style: Clean, 1.5px stroke width, rounded caps. Size: 24px default.

abstract_background.description: Subtle dark navy/purple blurry gradient. Use as an absolute positioned background layer with opacity-30 for soft atmospheric glow behind the dashboard.

family_teen.description: Calm teen portrait. Use in the Family tracking cards as an avatar.

recovery_map.description: Dark mode aerial city map. Use as the background for the Device Recovery tracking screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. This is a MOBILE FIRST app. Wrap the main layout in a container with max-w-[390px] and mx-auto to simulate a phone screen on desktop.
2. DO NOT USE ANY NUMBERS OR PERCENTAGES on the Home dashboard's main status panel. The user explicitly requested a 'calm' feeling. Just show 'Protected' or 'Learning'.
3. Apply the glass card recipe exactly as specified: bg-white/5, backdrop-blur-xl, border-white/10, rounded-3xl.
4. Highlight actions with the Electric Blue (#2563EB) and use Small Purple (#8B5CF6) for subtle accents like secondary icons or active navigation dot indicators.
5. NO HACKER LOOK. NO GREEN TERMINAL STYLE. NO NEON OVERLOAD. Keep the styling premium, deep navy, and extremely polished.
6. Include the slogan 'Your Digital Bodyguard. Your Trusted Mate.' in the Setup Completion screen or the settings section.

7. For the Stealth Cover, build a completely plain Calculator UI using stark black/white or normal colors that gives NO indication it's a security app. Add a logic to 'unlock' the app when a specific code is typed.
8. Apply data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for testing.
9. Use Lucide React for icons. Keep the design minimal and simple.
10. Ensure the fake Decoy phone screen looks like an absolute standard Android home screen with normal app icons (Chrome, Messages, Phone, Camera) - not branded by Digital Mate.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text on the navy background meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio.
